promoter_activity.rule: mean across the donor's frozen metacells of linked-gene log1p CP10K RNA

distal_accessibility.rule: mean across the donor's frozen metacells of log1p normalized ATAC over that interval's assigned consensus-peak set

n_assigned_peaks.rule: number of NIH-CARD consensus peaks overlapping the 5kb interval by >=1bp; no widening or nearest-peak rescue

rna_depth_sensitivity.rule: within-donor OLS slope of the linked gene's metacell RNA value on total RNA counts for the same metacells

atac_depth_sensitivity.rule: within-donor OLS slope of the interval's metacell ATAC value on total ATAC counts for the same metacells

n_metacells_contributing.rule: count of frozen donor metacells with the measurement support required for this donor-pair row

donor_pair_missing_if: linked gene has zero RNA counts in all donor metacells
assigned peak set has zero ATAC counts in all donor metacells
required measurement vector is otherwise unavailable under frozen support rules
missingness.degenerate_variance: belongs to Stage-4 correlation eligibility and must not be converted to a zero correspondence score

validation_requirements: all T5 pair_key values resolve to frozen Phase-A or enumeration-only pair mapping
all donor_id values belong to the 282 qualifying-donor universe
T5 values recompute exactly/tolerance-bound from frozen T2-T4 without returning to RNA/ATAC matrices
linked/A/B rows sharing a linked gene have identical promoter_activity within donor when their pair mapping references the same gene
no missing value is serialized as biological zero
T5 artifact bytes and producer are hash-bound
